gate-exchange-activitycenter 1.0.0

- Initial release of the activity center skill for platform campaigns.
- Supports activity recommendations by hot, type, scenario, or search keywords.
- Allows users to view "My Activities" entry card.
- Enforces strict API usage with a maximum of 3 results per request.
- Only specified MCP tools are permitted for this skill.
